definitions.explanation: A type of recurring headache characterized by intense, throbbing pain, usually on one side of the head.

examples.japanese: {偏頭痛|へんずつう}がひどい。
{偏頭痛|へんずつう}の{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}んだ。
{天気|てんき}が{変|か}わると{偏頭痛|へんずつう}が{起|お}きやすくなる。
examples.english: When the weather changes, I tend to get migraines more easily.

notes:
Written with {偏|へん} (one-sided) and {頭痛|ずつう} (headache), reflecting the characteristic one-sided pain. The medical term is {片頭痛|へんずつう}, using the kanji {片|へん} instead of {偏|へん}, but both writings are widely used. In medical literature, {片頭痛|へんずつう} is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偏頭痛|へんずつう}{持|も}ち: someone who suffers from migraines
- {偏頭痛|へんずつう}が{起|お}きる: to get a migraine
- {偏頭痛|へんずつう}の{発作|ほっさ}: migraine attack
- {偏頭痛|へんずつう}の{薬|くすり}: migraine medication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頭痛|ずつう}: headache — the general term for any headache
- {片頭痛|へんずつう}: migraine — the standard medical spelling with {片|へん}
- {緊張型|きんちょうがた}{頭痛|ずつう}: tension headache — a different type of headache caused by muscle tension
